alt: A short film with no voice. A dark blue bedroom at night with a bed, a wide window across the whole frame showing a flat night sky with twinkling stars, a small table lamp on a bedside table and, at the left, a blue screen that slowly fades. A small amber block figure with doorway legs and white eyes sits on the bed, stretches tall and yawns, then leans toward the lamp as it switches off with a click. It lowers its body, curls up a little and closes its eyes, breathing slowly. The words stay on screen: End of the feed, night scroller. Nothing else to do but rest.
